decisions.reason: As a web-map charting add-on built on the firm's core platform capabilities, and having already benefited from early rapid release learning, it is more likely to remain part of the offering than to be withdrawn.

As the firm's flagship GIS platform and a direct expression of its strategic direction, this product sits at the center of its accumulated knowledge base and is therefore very unlikely to be taken off the market.

Mobile field data capture is a close adjacent application to the firm's established geospatial integration expertise, so in-house R&D and customer feedback should continue to support incremental improvement rather than exit.

The search extension is closely related to the firm's existing web-map and enterprise GIS knowledge, and although such add-ons can be portfolio-rationalized, its fit with customer solutions still makes continuation more likely than withdrawal.
